parsed_json.up: Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, activities.standard_type, activities.standard_value, activities.standard_units. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Join activities to assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id. Join assays to target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid. Filter target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', activities.standard_units = 'nM', activities.standard_type in ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'), and activities.standard_value < 50. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by activity_id ascending. Limit to 200 rows.
